name: jengo/broadcasting
description: Enterprise-grade real-time event broadcasting subsystem for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework with Pusher, Soketi, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and Redis support.

facade.description: Primary static entry point providing fluent direct broadcasting, channel authorization rules, event dispatching, and testing fakes.

drivers.name: pusher
drivers.description: Native pure-PHP HTTP REST driver for Pusher Channels, Soketi, and Laravel Reverb with Pusher Protocol v7 authentication signing.

drivers.name: sse
drivers.description: Built-in, zero-daemon pure-PHP Server-Sent Events streaming engine with client reconnection recovery, channel multiplexing, and keep-alive heartbeats.

drivers.name: redis
drivers.description: High-throughput Redis Pub/Sub driver for distributed microservices or custom Go/Node.js socket gateways.

drivers.name: ably
drivers.description: Enterprise real-time platform driver communicating directly with Ably REST APIs.

drivers.name: log
drivers.description: Writes broadcast channels, event names, and payloads to the CodeIgniter 4 application log files.

drivers.name: null
drivers.description: Silently discards broadcast events for local development or disabled environments.

channels.name: Channel
channels.description: Public channel accessible to any client without authentication.

channels.name: PrivateChannel
channels.description: Private channel requiring user authorization via /broadcasting/auth. Automatically prefixed with private- on the wire.

channels.name: PresenceChannel
channels.description: Authenticated presence channel tracking connected members in real time. Automatically prefixed with presence- on the wire.

contracts.name: ShouldBroadcast
contracts.description: Marker interface for domain events that should be broadcast to channels.

contracts.name: ShouldBroadcastNow
contracts.description: Marker interface indicating immediate synchronous broadcast during the current request lifecycle without queueing.

attributes.name: BroadcastOn
attributes.description: Specifies the target broadcast channel(s) directly on an event class.

attributes.name: BroadcastAs
attributes.description: Specifies a custom broadcast event name.

attributes.name: BroadcastWith
attributes.description: Restricts event broadcasting payload to explicit property names.

helpers.name: broadcast
helpers.description: Dispatches an event object, initiates a fluent builder Broadcast::on(), or directly broadcasts to a channel.

commands.name: broadcast:routes
commands.description: List all registered channel authorization routes and wildcard pattern matchers.

commands.name: broadcast:test
commands.description: Dispatch a test broadcast event to verify channel connectivity.

commands.name: broadcast:sse
commands.description: Monitor and diagnostic log Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream activity.

installers.description: Publishes default configuration into app/Config/Broadcasting.php and creates app/Config/Channels.php.
